eventDetail.scope: The FTCS 2026 conference aims to bring together researchers, engineers and practitioners from around the globe to explore the latest advancements and emerging trends in the field of circuits and systems. With a thematic focus spanning integrated circuits, biomedical electronics, smart sensors and artificial intelligence technologies, FTCS 2026 will serve as a nexus for the dissemination of pioneering research and the exploration of novel methodologies.  The conference will feature keynote speeches, technical sessions, and tutorials. We welcome original research contributions on next-generation IC design, energy-efficient architectures, intelligent sensor networks, and their applications in healthcare, automotive, and industrial systems.
